title: Malevolent Force Horror
eyebrow: The Malevolent Force · more horror · round 9
heading: Suspense strings, and the prices drawn in the edit
intro: Two things. The music: your suspense-strings pick, six genuinely different string ideas from separate writers, two takes each (15 s, instrumental). Each has a player with a slider: play it right here. The prices: as you asked, the cards are now blank in Flow and the prices are drawn in the edit, changing in the hand's wake as it passes over them (shelf 50p → £5; freezer £5 → £50, 10p crossed out → £12). Pick one per row.

sections.lede: Play the strings with the cut in mind: they replace vibes1 under the whole short; a stab gets placed on each scare in the edit.
